name: ケンコバのほろ酔いビジホ泊
original_name: ケンコバのほろ酔いビジホ泊
overview:
The programme features Kendo Kobayashi introducing business hotels across the country. In the first half, he tours the business hotel where he is staying that night and tries out the facilities; when using the hotel’s bathing facilities, he wears flesh-coloured underpants for the camera. Afterwards, he leaves the hotel and takes a leisurely stroll through the surrounding streets, ending up slightly tipsy in the entertainment district.

When walking through the entertainment district, if he comes across establishments—such as adult entertainment venues—that would be inappropriate to show on television, a purple blur is applied to ensure that the shop names and general appearance remain hidden from viewers.
